rows.context_and_review_note: ImageImport.kt:161–162 BitmapFactory.decodeFile returns null. Proposed s fsi decode term needs independent lexical validation; must not use literal dissolve/untie meaning or collapse this into absent provider data. No claim of unsupported format, damage or memory exhaustion.
rows.original_value: ⵓⵔ ⵉⵣⵎⵉⵔ Android ⴰⴷ ⵉⵙⴼⵙⵉ ⵜⴰⵡⵍⴰⴼⵜ ⴰ.
rows.independent_review_note: Held for real semantic uncertainty: ⵉⵙⴼⵙⵉ suggests dissolve/unravel, and I cannot establish a defensible technical decoding sense. A replacement must describe Android failing to interpret image encoding, not absent provider data, unsupported format, corruption, or memory exhaustion. Merely changing to generic no readable data would lose the failure-stage distinction.
